name: homelab-manager
description: Real-time homelab monitoring dashboard for Docker, ZFS, and Proxmox with TimescaleDB-backed metrics (alpha)

paragraphs: A real-time monitoring dashboard for homelab infrastructure, built on TanStack Start.
Try the live demo at jaredglaser.github.io/homelab-manager - no setup required. The demo runs entirely in the browser with deterministic mock data.
This project is a work in progress. Features are incomplete, APIs may change, and the codebase is under active development. See Roadmap for planned features.
features: Docker Dashboard - Real-time CPU, memory, block I/O, and network metrics for all containers with inline sparkline charts
ZFS Dashboard - Hierarchical view of pools, vdevs, and disks with capacity, IOPS, and bandwidth metrics via agent sidecar
Proxmox Dashboard - Cluster overview with per-node CPU, memory, and disk metrics via REST API polling
Host Management - Add and configure managed Docker hosts via a setup wizard; agent sidecars handle stats streaming, log access, and deployments
Secrets Management - JWE-encrypted stack secrets and per-agent keypairs stored in TimescaleDB

whatItDoes.text: A real-time monitoring dashboard for homelab infrastructure, built on TanStack Start.

requirements.text: What shipped in each version is in CHANGELOG.md, and which image tag to run is covered in the self-hosting guide.
